scope: Third 33-frame metric flower simulation smoke with complete exact assets
summary: Rendering, robot, stem, force, hand, force-closure, causal-response, and video gates passed, but the camera stage rejected a left-handed world-from-camera rotation.
evidence: Robot trajectory, stem centerlines, and contact forces passed while metric_camera alone failed.
The rotation orthogonality error was only 3.14e-16, isolating the failure to the negative determinant rather than numerical drift.
The video decoded all 33 frames and the run completed in 4.4931 seconds.
lessons: Image-down camera coordinates cannot be inserted as SE(3) columns without preserving a proper right-handed rotation.
limitations: An improper camera transform invalidates metric projection even when all other physical state is finite.
next_actions: Recover the MuJoCo image-right axis with a proper rotation and rerun the complete smoke.
